title: fix(runtime,hono): an exact /approvals/act dispatcher domain for kernels with no raw app, and a catch-all that leaves the raw request readable
body:
Fixes #22576
Clause-②: no

Segment 2 of ruling A on #22438 (maintainer ruling recorded verbatim as 「A + 扫类」). A hosted tenant kernel owns no socket, so it has no raw Hono app for `plugin-approvals` to mount the ADR-0043 action page on: on that shape `GET`/`POST /api/v1/approvals/act` answered `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, and every approve / reject link in every approval message was dead. This PR gives the dispatcher that route and makes the Hono catch-all stop eating the body the route needs.

## What changed

**`@objectstack/runtime`**
- New dispatcher domain `packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals.ts`, registered in `HttpDispatcher` the way `/auth` is (ADR-0076 D11: the dispatcher owns registration, one route bridges to one service slot). It claims exactly `/approvals/act` (`match: 'exact'`) for `GET`, `HEAD` and `POST`, resolves the request kernel's `approvals` slot, and forwards `context.request` unread to `IApprovalService.handleActionPage`, returning that `Response` untouched.
- `HEAD`: forwarded to the member as a `GET` and answered with that page's status and headers and no body, which is what the self-hosted mount answers (measured, below). It renders; it never decides.
- Absent slot, or a service without `handleActionPage`: `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (an existing standard code), with a message naming which. Never `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.
- A member that throws: sanitised `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, original error logged (the `/auth` discipline). A `POST` whose body a transport already consumed: also `500`, logged, and the member is not asked; otherwise the member would show the approver an "invalid link" page for a live link.
- `enforceProjectMembership` skips the exact act path (unscoped or `/environments/:id`-scoped), and only it. See decision 3.
- `route-ledger.ts`: two `public` rows (`GET`/`POST /approvals/act`), census 82 to 84.

**`@objectstack/hono`**
- The `${prefix}/*` catch-all and the `/auth/*` legacy fallback parse the JSON body from `c.req.raw.clone()` instead of `c.req.json()`, so `context.request` reaches the dispatcher with its body unread, for every content type, JSON included. The parsed `body` domains get is unchanged for every input (same `text()` then `JSON.parse`, same `{}` on any failure). A body something upstream already read through `c.req` falls back to `c.req.json()` (Hono's cache), as before.

**Pins and bookkeeping (no published surface)**
- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`: declares `approvals.ts` with `handBuilt: 0`.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance`: devDependency on `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` (aliased to source in its vitest config) so one suite can boot the real plugin on both doors; `pnpm-lock.yaml` gains the 3-line importer link.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`: the two new rows are pinned as unobservable on the self-hosted showcase boot, where `plugin-approvals` serves the path from `rawApp.get`/`rawApp.post`, never through the `IHttpServer` port (the same reason the `/auth/**` row is pinned).

No new error code, no new package-entry export (the domain module is not exported from `@objectstack/runtime`'s index), no spec, `packages/core` or `plugin-approvals` source change.

## The claim's four decisions, as measured

1. **Hono, option A.** Premise "the parsed body domains see is unchanged" is pinned per input against a reference Hono app running the old line: spaced JSON object, array, `null`, number, string, BOM-prefixed JSON, JSON sent as `text/plain`, invalid JSON, empty body, form body, plain text, no content type. All unchanged; every one now also reads back byte for byte from the request at dispatch. Nothing measured broke.
2. **HEAD.** Measured first on the real composition (real `HonoServerPlugin` socket + real `ApprovalsServicePlugin` raw-app mount): `HEAD /api/v1/approvals/act` answers `200`, the `GET` page's headers minus `content-length`, empty body, for a live and a dead token. The hosted door (real `createHonoApp`, real dispatcher, real member) answers identically. One conformance pin holds both doors equal.
3. **Membership gate.** Premise measured TRUE before any skip existed: through `dispatch()` on a multi-tenant host, a signed-in caller who is not a member of the resolved environment got `403 PROJECT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED` and the member never ran, while an anonymous caller with the same link reached it. So the exact act path joined the skip; pins cover GET, POST, the scoped spelling, an anonymous control, and five neighbours that are still checked (`/approvals/act/x`, `/approvals/actx`, `/approvals`, `/approvals/requests`, `/data/task`). No other auth change.
4. **Cross-segment ablation.** On the real `ApprovalService`, `handleActionPage` removed on purpose: the hosted door answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on GET, HEAD and POST; with no `approvals` slot: `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, while the control path `/approvals/actx` on the same door is the route miss `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.

## Pins

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals-act.test.ts` (12): real `HttpDispatcher` on a kernel with no `http.server` and a stub member that reads its own token.
- `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono-catch-all-raw-request.test.ts` (17): the catch-all's preservation and raw-body halves, PUT/PATCH, GET/DELETE unchanged, the upstream-consumed fallback, the `/auth/*` fallback.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-approvals-act.conformance.test.ts` (4): the real plugin on both doors; a form POST through the hosted door redeems a live token (the decision lands in the store), HEAD parity, the cross-segment 501s.

## Ablations (one-off, committed state, restore proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and empty `git diff HEAD`)

- Hono fix reverted to `c.req.json()` in the catch-all: 14 of 17 hono pins red on `bodyUsed` (preservation assertions held), 3 unrelated green.
- Domain registration removed, runtime `dist/` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` green: all 4 hosted conformance pins red with `404`; the runtime suite on source shows the body: `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, "Route Not Found: /approvals/act" (11 of 12 red, the neighbour control green). Restore leg: rebuilt, marker present in 2 dist files, mutation marker absent, 4 of 4 green.
- Dogfood pin key renamed: the parity gate reports `GET /approvals/act — LEDGERED BUT NOT MOUNTED` plus the stale pin (2 of 8 red), so the pin is load-bearing.

## Verification

Measured on ``427772e14``, origin/main `ee3ae0360` merged in.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `local` project in three chunks, 143 + 106 + 97 files, 2569 + 1281 + 1071 tests passed (19 skipped); `repo` project 3 files, 751 passed; `typecheck` (src + test layer) 0.
- `@objectstack/hono`: `test` 6 files, 139 passed; `typecheck` 0.
- `@objectstack/http-conformance`: 10 files, 110 passed; `typecheck` 0.
- `@objectstack/dogfood`: `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` 8 of 8; `typecheck` 0. The rest of that suite is CI's.
- Gates: all 100 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff (the dispatch list's 49 plus 51 the diff adds) exit 0 at `427772e14`; `dispatch-gates --ran` with each exit recorded: 100 derived, 100 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two needed a prerequisite on the way, now met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit `621a48760` fetched into this shallow checkout, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed the whole workspace built (107 entries across 66 packages load). Two were red on this diff and fixed in it: `check:route-envelope` (the new domain file declared) and `check:route-ledger-census` (82 to 84).
- Lint, narrowed and proven: the population is `eslint.config.mjs`'s own `files` globs minus `NEVER_LINTED`; `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 10 touched lintable files reports 10 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings (none ignored). Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules, stated in the config itself), and the diff touches none of the config's own inputs, so it cannot move the verdict of an untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The question on AGENTS.md route rule 5 (closed query-parameter set). Measured on both doors: `?token=LIVE&utm_source=mail&zzz=1` renders the same confirm page as `?token=LIVE`, `200`. The self-hosted mount reads `token` and ignores the rest, and so does the member; this domain reads no query parameter at all. Rule 5's subject is a REST handler that reads `req.query` and can silently drop a filter. Here the reader is the member, and a mail link may legitimately carry parameters a gateway or tracker appended. So no closed set is invented here; whether the member should declare one is the approvals contract's call.
- Methods other than GET/HEAD/POST on the act path: the hosted door answers the dispatcher's `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, the self-hosted door plugin-hono-server's `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`. Both are 404 with different codes. Pre-existing on the self-hosted side, out of this card's scope.
- The scoped spelling `/api/v1/environments/:id/approvals/act` reaches the domain through the dispatcher's generic scope strip; the self-hosted mount has no such spelling. The membership skip and the ADR-0069 allow-list (#22577's) both treat it like the unscoped path.
- Cost of option A: a body-carrying request through the catch-all is buffered twice for the life of the request (the tee), and on `@hono/node-server` the direct-read fast path is no longer taken for POST/PUT/PATCH. These are API bodies the old path already buffered whole.
- The log window noted by segment 4 (#22578): the plugin's hosted log line says the pages "are served through the HTTP dispatcher's /approvals/act domain". That sentence becomes true when this lands.
- The branch was not re-merged after `ee3ae0360`; the commits since touch none of these files. CI's merge ref covers the rest.
